_meta.description: Split a media budget across four channels: each channel's response is a saturating hill() curve, the `optimize` block maximises the total response subject to one `eq` budget constraint (spend sums to params.budget), and the social channel is capped by a bound read from params. In `optimizations`, every channel strictly between its bounds has the same marginal (marginal ROI equalised) and that value is the budget constraint's multiplier, the shadow price of one more unit of budget; a channel with active `upper` has a marginal above it (raise the cap to gain), one at its lower bound below it. No model is fitted; a fitted channel curve would come from coef() over a `fits` entry.
_meta.name: compose-budget-allocation
